facts.claim: 吉纳维芙手捧装有母亲骨灰的骨灰瓮，站在露台上准备致辞。
facts.quote: In her hands she held the urn that contained the ashes of her mother.

facts.claim: 吉纳维芙转述母亲临终前的问话：你原谅我吗。
facts.quote: What she said was, ‘Do you forgive me?’

facts.claim: 吉纳维芙坦白当时说原谅并非真话，真相更复杂：她还没准备好原谅母亲。
facts.quote: “It wasn’t the truth. The truth was more complicated, as it often is.

facts.claim: 罗斯一声不响地把骨灰撒过栏杆，完成这场神圣的托付。
facts.quote: Rose did so without fanfare or delay, saying nothing

facts.claim: 众人进屋后，吉纳维芙与儿子塞思合奏一曲，令所有人意外。
facts.quote: Genevieve surprised us all by playing a duet with her son

facts.claim: 叙述者把这场聚会称作“反结局”：她以暗示的方式，一个人一个人地掩埋真相。
facts.quote: in which I buried the truth by way of innuendo, one person at a time

facts.claim: 吉纳维芙当面告诉罗斯，她从一开始就知道是罗斯毁了小提琴。
facts.quote: I knew right away you were the one who ruined my violin.

facts.claim: 吉纳维芙在炉火前告诉叙述者，她不想再写回忆录了。
facts.quote: I don’t want to write a memoir anymore,

relations.rel: 父女：吉纳维芙当众原谅父亲，塞缪尔终于失声痛哭。
relations.quote: Samuel lost his composure finally and let out a sob

relations.rel: 母子：吉纳维芙揽住儿子，塞思没有躲开。
relations.quote: Genevieve put her arm around Seth, who didn’t shrug her off.

relations.rel: 雇主与管家：吉纳维芙说明解雇与小提琴无关，并提议把钱捐给慈善机构。
relations.quote: Oh, you’re also fired. Not because of the violin thing,

relations.rel: 恋人：阿比把头靠在丹尼胸前，丹尼把她搂得更紧。
relations.quote: Abi laid her head against Denny’s chest, and he drew her in closer

relations.rel: 好友：吉纳维芙反问玛丽莲是否嫉妒自己，玛丽莲最终承认有一点。
父子：丹抚摸着儿子的后脑勺。
relations.quote: Dan patting the back of his son’s head

numbers.claim: 吉纳维芙对罗斯谎称修琴只花了五千美元，实为替她减轻负担。
罗斯塞给吉纳维芙的信封里是一沓百元钞票。
numbers.quote: I could see a stack of hundred-dollar bills inside

numbers.claim: 众人将近午夜才各自回房睡觉。
numbers.quote: It was close to midnight by the time everyone went to bed.

numbers.claim: 叙述者估计罗斯一周内、最多两周就会搬走。
numbers.quote: I gave her a week before she was out of the house—two weeks maximum.

numbers.claim: 母子合奏的是巴赫为两把独奏小提琴写的《双小提琴协奏曲》末乐章。
numbers.quote: a piece written for two violin soloists by Johann Sebastian Bach

numbers.claim: 最后只剩叙述者与吉纳维芙坐在炉火前的两把扶手椅上。
numbers.quote: we sat for a while in the two armchairs in front of the fire

numbers.claim: 吉纳维芙说她的原谅其实有一个条件：父亲必须原谅肯。
numbers.quote: my forgiveness actually has one condition

numbers.claim: 吉纳维芙在“舒适城堡”里睡了很久，叙述者估计有好几个小时。
numbers.quote: It had been many hours since I left her asleep in her Cozy Castle

numbers.claim: 几分钟后罗斯拦住吉纳维芙，把信封塞进她手里。
numbers.quote: Rose accosted Genevieve a few minutes later

numbers.claim: 叙述者自认是众多伤害过吉纳维芙的人之一。
numbers.quote: I was one in a long line of people who had victimized Genevieve Caraway

numbers.claim: 敲门后几秒钟门就开了。
叙述者形容自己是一个接一个地用暗示掩埋真相。
numbers.quote: one person at a time, as opposed to rounding up everyone

turning_point: 吉纳维芙在骨灰撒完后当众宣布原谅父亲，又在炉火前决定放弃写回忆录；叙述者由此确认自己与凯的计划必须继续隐瞒，两人的合作到此结束。
notes: 叙述者姓名全章未出现；“the Bach Double”指巴赫《d 小调双小提琴协奏曲》BWV 1043，原文只说 final movement。第 7 行 “Gene vieve” 为原文排版断字，未作改动。
